title: Synthesis, structure, and antimicrobial activity of a series of novel heterocyclic azo-colorants derived from α-dicarbonyl compounds
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24128-24140
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10033J, Paper
Open Access

Thi Ngoc Anh Vu, Nadezhda Polyanskaya, Svetlana Bozhenkova, Viktor Khrustalev, Andrey Utenyshev, Anton Shetnev, Igor Filenko, Minh Chin Huynh, Anh Van Nguyen, Olga Kovalchukova
Six novel α-dicarbonyl-derived azo–hydrazones were identified as potent, bioavailable antibacterial leads with low toxicity. Their broad-spectrum inhibitory potential and drug-like profiles were confirmed via molecular docking and ADMET analyses.
